question: Which supreme deities are affected by the sight of the accomplished practitioner?
premises: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra are named
Other best among gods are included
These deities are subjects of reaction
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and other foremost gods are among those affected.
plain_english: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, and those gods who are the best among the gods.
